## Gate 2: manual review (the author ticks every box)

Automated Gate 1 checks must be green first. Then:

- [ ] Every acceptance criterion in the ticket is met (list them below with pass or fail)
- [ ] Tried on a **real phone** (or 375px) and a **desktop** (1440px)
- [ ] Checked in **light and dark** mode
- [ ] Keyboard only: every control reachable, visible focus, no traps; touch targets at least 48px
- [ ] No console errors in the browser on the pages changed
- [ ] Row Level Security enabled and tested for every new table (or no new tables)
- [ ] No hardcoded brand, domain, phone number or city; market data comes from the database
- [ ] Every new boundary is validated with Zod; no secrets committed; new env vars in `.env.example`
